title: Design Day Bangalore — Transportation & Cities
description:
Design Day Bangalore is back after a long break and with a topic, Bangalore would definitely be interested in.

The urban landscape is changing fast. In India and around the world, the reality of more people living in cities than in rural areas is hitting us hard.

Some places have managed this far better than the others. The city dweller of India is happy to turn away and hope that things will get better on their own.

In this event, we will get inside the soul of an urban commuter to find out what really 'drives' us to this level of indifference and perhaps what can be done about it.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Seats are limited. First come First Serve basis. Be on time :)

Speakers
